best_hook.why: Chained, tear-streaked woman in a dungeon: 'Do you know they condemned me?' - stakes in one line

best_cliffhanger.why: Wedding bells toll and she realises 'Then I suppose I'm next' - execution imminent, rescue unknown

must_promos.why: Condemned wife fears dying without seeing her husband, vows not to betray him, then the bells start and she grips the bars: 'I suppose I'm next'

standalone_risk: No antagonist on screen: a stranger does not know who condemned her, why, or who Alexander is, and the bells-mean-wedding-means-execution link is cryptic without prior episodes
notes: Quiet single-character episode; the guard's bread is tender but not a scroll-stopper.
